responsibility: Implements the GIMPLE pass that analyzes formatted output calls such as sprintf and snprintf. It parses format strings, combines object-size, pointer-query, ranger, strlen, and MPFR-backed directive-length reasoning to estimate minimum and maximum output sizes, diagnoses likely overflow or truncation under -Wformat-length/-Wformat-overflow style options, and, when safe and enabled, folds known formatted-output return values or simplifies the calls based on the computed result lengths.
